about: The model pages' fixed copy for refused model actions and settings (T12.30): apps/desktop/src-tauri (models_tests.rs) checks `models::catalogue_copy`, `models::settings_copy` and their constants against this table, and packages/ui/src/ipc/mockModels.test.ts checks the mock's refusals, so the mock's copy cannot drift from Rust. `rust_only` holds copy the mock never shows (it has no model files to fail on): only the desktop's test reads it. {model} stands for the model's display name, {missing} for the missing languages joined with ", ".

rust_only.model_files_failed: Earshot could not read or change its model files. Close Earshot, open it again and try once more.

fixed.unknown_model: That model is not part of this version of Earshot.
fixed.unknown_transcription_model: That transcription model is not part of this version of Earshot. Choose another one.
fixed.unknown_summary_model: That summary model is not part of this version of Earshot. Choose another one.
fixed.unknown_language: No transcription model understands one of the chosen meeting languages. Choose another one.
fixed.no_languages: choose at least one meeting language
fixed.npu_for_summaries: summaries cannot run on the NPU

templates.chosen: {model} is in use; choose another model first
templates.model_languages: {model} does not transcribe {missing}; choose a multilingual model
